args.query: consumer lag poison message deserialize schema mismatch

events.statement: settlement-service logged deserialization failures on OrderExecuted starting at 07:42:14Z: 'missing required field qty (schema v1 expected, header says v2)' at orders-3@8841207, then poison-message retries blocking the partition.
order-service deployment dep-6010 (v2.16.0) completed rollout at 07:40:01Z and its change summary is 'OrderExecuted event: rename field qty -> quantity' plus 'event schema version header v2'.
The only config change in the window was cfg-3004 on settlement-service changing consumer.max.poll.records from 500 to 200 at 07:35:00Z ('Smaller poll batches to smooth DB writes').
settlement-service consumer_lag was ~40 messages until 07:36, then rose from 1506 (07:42 bucket) to 60124 by 09:54, and request_rate collapsed from ~62 req/s to 0.4 req/s at 07:48.
settlement-service CPU rose from ~28% to ~70% after 07:36 and stayed there; DB pool in use stayed flat at ~6 connections; no restarts occurred.
settlement-service error_rate (HTTP 5xx) stayed flat at ~0.2% throughout, and order-service itself logged only INFO/WARN with no errors in the window.
kafka logged only two benign WARN 'retrying idempotent request after connection reset' messages (07:27:08 and 09:51:04) with no broker rebalance or partition-reassignment events.
settlement-service consumes from kafka queue and writes to ledger-db (postgres); both are shared platform components with telemetry.
Historical incidents HIST-104 and HIST-112 describe settlement/notification lag from Kafka broker rebalance and partition reassignment, not schema mismatch.

The first settlement deserialize error (07:42:14) occurs ~2 minutes after the order-service v2 deployment completed (07:40:01) and ~7 minutes after the poll config change (07:35); the error names a schema version mismatch, not a batch/poll issue.
